definition.name: NXxas

symbols.doc: The symbol(s) listed here will be used below to coordinate datasets with the same shape.

symbol.name: nP
symbol.doc: Number of spectra (scan points). For a stack, ``nP`` is the length of the first dimension of ``intensity``. Spectra can be appended along this dimension during the measurement. For a single spectrum, ``nP`` is 1, and ``intensity`` has no ``nP`` dimension.

symbol.name: dataRank
symbol.doc: Rank of the ``intensity`` field: 1 for a single spectrum ``[nEnergy]`` or 2 for a stack of spectra ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

definition.doc:
Application definition for X-ray absorption spectroscopy. This is a generic definition that technique-specific application definitions extend.
All these definitions also accept non-experimental spectra, for example calculated spectra or spectra reconstructed from reference components.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

field.name: title
field.doc: Human-readable title for the measurement or calculation.

field.name: start_time
field.doc: Start time of the measurement. Omit for calculated or reconstructed spectra.

field.name: end_time
field.doc: End time of the measurement.

group.name: edge
group.doc: The absorption edge (for example ``K``, ``L1``, ``L2``, or ``L3``). Together with the absorbing element, it uniquely identifies the probed electronic transition.

field.name: energy
field.doc: The energy axis of the spectrum.

field.name: intensity
field.doc: The intensity of the spectrum. The physical quantity in ``intensity`` depends on the acquisition mode.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

attribute.name: type
attribute.doc: The physical quantity that ``intensity`` represents before any processing (for example, background subtraction, normalization, or scaling). Each technique-specific application definition lists the allowed values.

attribute.name: provenance
attribute.doc: The provenance of the values in ``intensity``. The :ref:`processing </NXxas/ENTRY/processing-group>` group can describe the measurement, calculation, or reconstruction.

item.doc: Acquired at a beamline or laboratory instrument.
Reconstructed from reference components, for example by linear combination fitting, PCA, or MCR-ALS.

field.name: intensity_errors
field.doc: The estimated uncertainty associated with each ``intensity`` value, expressed as a standard deviation.

dimensions.doc: Same shape as ``intensity``: ``[nEnergy]`` when ``dataRank`` is 1, or ``[nP, nEnergy]`` when ``dataRank`` is 2.

field.name: name
field.doc: Descriptive name of the sample

field.name: temperature
field.doc: Sample temperature, one value per spectrum.

dimensions.doc: The shape is ``[nP]``. For a stack, it matches the leading dimension of ``intensity``. ``nP`` is 1 for a single spectrum.

group.doc: Instrument used to measure the spectrum. Omit for calculated or reconstructed spectra.

field.name: d_spacing
field.doc: The spacing between crystal planes of the reflection

field.name: type
field.doc: Crystal material or dispersing element (for example Si, Ge, or multilayer).

field.name: reflection
field.doc: Miller indices (hkl) values of nominal reflection

group.name: energy_resolution
group.doc: Energy resolution of the monochromator (FWHM). Give it in particular for a grating monochromator, which has no crystal.

field.name: resolution
field.doc: Minimum distinguishable energy separation :math:`\Delta E` of the incident X-rays. If only the resolving power :math:`E/\Delta E` is known, give :math:`\Delta E` at the absorption edge energy.

group.name: i0
group.doc: Detector measuring the incident beam intensity :math:`I_0`.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

attribute.name: signal
attribute.doc: Name of the field to plot: the absorption ``intensity``.

group.doc:
Plot of ``intensity`` versus ``energy``. The ``energy`` and ``intensity`` links are required. Additional coordinate links are allowed.
For a single spectrum, ``energy`` spans dimension 0 (``@energy_indices = 0``). For a stack, ``energy`` has ``@energy_indices = 1`` and the quantity that varies across the stack (for example time, spatial position, or sample state) is the leading axis with ``@AXISNAME_indices = 0``.
Store that quantity in its standard NeXus location (for example ``NXsample/temperature``, ``NXsample/electric_field``, an ``NXsample/NXtransformations`` axis, or an ``NXbeam`` polarization field) and link it here. This application definition lists only the ``energy`` coordinate. Add any other coordinate field in its base-class group and link it to this ``NXdata`` group.

field.name: mode
field.deprecated: Use a technique-specific subclass of :ref:`NXxas` instead.
field.doc: Detection method used for observing the sample absorption (pick one from the enumerated list and spell exactly)

group.name: raw_data
group.doc: Raw data as written by the acquisition or calculation software, preserved without modification.

group.name: processing
group.doc:
Provenance of :ref:`intensity </NXxas/ENTRY/intensity-field>`.
Include all processing steps from raw data to the spectrum in ``intensity``. For calculated spectra, also identify the calculation software and its inputs. For reconstructed spectra, also identify the reference components and their contributions.
Do not store compiled programs or other binary executables in this group.

field.name: program
field.doc: Name of the processing program.

field.name: version
field.doc: Version of the program identified by ``program``.

field.name: date
field.doc: Date and time of processing.

group.name: parameters
group.doc: Processing parameter values. Include a ``units`` attribute for each parameter where applicable.

group.name: note
group.doc: Description of the processing. Identify the input data and give the processing steps in order.

field.name: type
field.doc: MIME type of ``data``.

field.name: data
field.doc: Description of the processing as plain text.

group.name: reference
group.doc: An independent reference spectrum, for example from a reference sample (such as a metal foil) used for energy calibration. Store the reference spectrum here when it is a complete spectrum in its own right, in particular when it probes a different absorbing element or absorption edge, or when it is measured in a different acquisition mode than the sample spectrum (for example a reference sample measured in transmission mode while the sample is measured in fluorescence mode).

field.name: definition
field.doc: NeXus NXDL schema to which this subentry conforms

group.name: reference
group.doc: A reference spectrum cannot contain another reference spectrum.
